topic: Venus's clouds lap the planet in 4 days
script: Venus's clouds race around the planet far faster than the planet itself spins. The planet takes about 243 Earth days to turn once. But its cloud tops circle it in only about 4 Earth days. Winds up there blow at roughly 360 kilometers per hour. Scientists call this super-rotation, and they are still working out what drives it. The clouds themselves are made of sulfuric acid droplets.
